text: The slot holds the head `discriminant` for `tinyclip-8m-16` (shrinkage 0.3), fitted on `images/alachua-pre2025`, with 5467 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 1, w_kind 0.7, alpha_prior 0.5. On 1803 tuning photos (val) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.90 and offer_at 0.97. On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 80.3% (79.0 to 81.6); the top species is right for 42.5% (41.1 to 44.0) and is among the first five for 65.5% (64.1 to 66.9). `person` was said for 0.02% of these photos and `none` for 0.05%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind rows fitted on the fitting photos and the extra set (every photo counts the same)`. With kind_at 0.82 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 58.4% (56.9 to 60.0) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 96.2% (95.4 to 96.9) of those; for the 41.6% (40.0 to 43.1) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 91.5% (90.1 to 92.7). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`), the kind is right for 95.4% (94.2 to 96.5); the page asserts a kind for 86.8% (84.8 to 88.7) and is right for 98.9% (98.2 to 99.4) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 92.7% (88.4 to 96.3). A species is named on 15.1% (13.1 to 17.1) of these photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); kinds.bias (build 7 of the page); fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).

extra.text: The 1240 test photos of the extra set `coco-kinds` (COCO photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms with nothing alive; vectors `images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through the same slot, each with a calendar month drawn by a hash of its id. A species name on a photo of a person or a room is always wrong.
